description: Return available federal-contractor records for a requested date — pass uei or cage plus as_of=YYYY-MM-DD. Retained history is currently limited to USASpending award rows; SAM.gov registration and exclusions, FAPIIS, and ownership fields may be current, absent, or nullable and are not universal replay. Provenance values are nullable and source-specific, and returned facts have no deterministic link to a signature. Source records and deterministic summaries only — no risk score or verdict. Read-only.

uei.description: 12-char GSA Unique Entity ID (provide uei OR cage)

name: fonteum_get_record_as_of
title: Get a record as of a captured date
